description.narrative: Climate Smart Research and Innovation for Livestock Development in Kenya with a focus on Dairying. Implementation Partner: Teagasc (Lead) Working with Sustainable Food Systems Ireland, Greenfield International, Kenya Agricultural Research Organization – Naivasha and Self Help Africa. Project goal to contribute to the knowledge and on-farm practice around innovative climate smart and economic production systems through the introduction of forage-based animal genetics and the use of novel climate smart forage feeding systems on-farm. Activities : Development of a new cattle development programme (Economic Breeding Index), develop and demonstrate new improved systems of production (forage based) which can meet 90%+ of the animal’s dietary requirement from forage and which are resilient in terms of climate change, to develop an Innovation Hub in support of the dairy value chain with a particular focus on innovation support on-farm and which can build capacity in forage-based production technology through existing extension networks and routes to lead farmers via external Innovation Nodes. Target Group: Male and female Small Holder farmers
